2609.24662.title: DUMA-Bench: A Dual-Control Multi-Agent Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent Security
2609.24662.paper_summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in environments where they interact with users, tools, and external systems. Yet most security evaluations assume passive users and static control, ignoring the interactive dynamics that shape real agent behavior. We introduce \textbf{DUMA-Bench}, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring agent security under \emph{dual-control} interaction, where both the agent and the user can influence the shared environment state. DUMA-Bench extends $τ^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau} with adversarial environments covering eight vulnerability classes, including RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, and unsafe output handling. We evaluate \textbf{14 models from five model families} (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Z.ai) across eight domains and multiple user-behavior regimes. Across our experiments, introducing dual-control interaction increases the attack success rate from \textbf{26.9\%} to \textbf{41.1\%}. These results show that agent security is not solely a property of the model but emerges from the interaction between the model, the user, and the environment. DUMA-Bench provides a missing evaluation layer for studying security in realistic agent deployments.
2609.24662.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理越來越多地在與用戶、工具和外部系統互動的環境中運作。<lb/>然而，大多數安全評估假設用戶是被動的，控制是靜態的，忽視了塑造真實代理行為的互動動態。<lb/>我們介紹了 \textbf{DUMA-Bench}，這是一個基準和評估協議，用於測量在 \emph{雙重控制} 互動下的代理安全性，其中代理和用戶都可以影響共享環境狀態。<lb/>DUMA-Bench 擴展了 $τ^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau}，涵蓋了八個漏洞類別的對抗性環境，包括 RAG 中毒、跨代理操控和不安全的輸出處理。<lb/>我們評估了來自五個模型家族的 \textbf{14 個模型}（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、Qwen 和 Z.ai），涵蓋八個領域和多種用戶行為模式。<lb/>在我們的實驗中，引入雙重控制互動將攻擊成功率從 \textbf{26.9\%} 提高到 \textbf{41.1\%}。<lb/>這些結果表明，代理安全性不僅僅是模型的屬性，而是模型、用戶和環境之間互動的產物。<lb/>DUMA-Bench 為研究現實代理部署中的安全性提供了一個缺失的評估層。
